name: Trust Teddy Connector for WooCommerce
author: ttdev2

sections.description:
Let your customers give a gift without knowing the recipient’s shipping address.

Trust Teddy adds a gifting option to your WooCommerce checkout. Recipients choose whether to accept and provide their own delivery details upon acceptance. Your store fulfills the accepted gift.

Your Privacy is Our Priority.

How it works

  1. Choose Trust Teddy. The customer selects Trust Teddy at checkout and completes the gift details.
  2. Invite the recipient. A private invitation link allows the recipient to review and accept or decline the gift.
  3. Provide delivery details. Upon acceptance, the recipient enters their shipping address.
  4. Fulfill the gift. Your store receives the delivery information needed to prepare and ship the accepted gift.

Features

  • Gifting without an address: Customers can purchase gifts without knowing where the recipient lives.
  • Recipient choice: Recipients decide whether to accept or decline.
  • Recipient-provided delivery details: Shipping information comes directly from the person receiving the gift.
  • Gift status updates: Follow recipient responses through your store’s order statuses.
  • Merchant fulfillment: Your store handles preparation and shipping.

Getting started

Install and activate Trust Teddy Connector for WooCommerce, then register your store through the Trust Teddy settings.

Trust Teddy merchant approval is required before your store can process gifts.

External services

This plugin connects to Trust Teddy Core, a service operated by Trust Teddy at http://testingbms.info:3100. Trust Teddy Core sends the gift invitation, hosts the recipient’s accept/decline and address pages, and returns the delivery details to your store. The plugin does not work without it.

Data sent from your store to Trust Teddy Core:

  • When you register your store: your store’s URL and name, your WordPress admin email address, and your contact phone number (if entered).
  • When you save the Trust Teddy settings: your admin email address and contact phone number, to keep your contact details current.
  • When the settings page or checkout loads: your store’s Merchant ID, to check whether your store is approved. No customer data is sent.
  • When a customer places a Trust Teddy order: the order number, the items (name, quantity, price and product image link), the order total and currency, and the buyer’s name, email address, phone number and customer account ID.
  • When the customer completes the gift details: the recipient’s name and phone number and/or email address, the buyer’s name, phone number and email address, and the optional gift message.

Data sent from Trust Teddy Core to your store:

  • Gift status updates (invited, declined or expired), shown as order statuses.
  • When the recipient accepts: the recipient’s name and shipping address, saved to the order’s shipping details, and the gift message, saved as an order note.

Trust Teddy uses this information to deliver the gift invitation and email/SMS status notifications to the buyer, the recipient and you. Payment card details are never sent to Trust Teddy; payment is handled by your store’s own payment gateway.

This service is provided by Trust Teddy: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Trust Teddy Connector for WooCommerce (WooCommerce must already be installed and active).
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Trust Teddy.
  3. (Optional) Enter a Contact Phone in E.164 format (e.g. +15551234567) to also receive SMS notifications.
  4. Click “Register with Trust Teddy Core”.
  5. Wait for Trust Teddy to approve your store. Until then, the Trust Teddy option is not shown at checkout.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active on your WordPress website.

Does Trust Teddy ship the gifts?

No. Your store prepares and ships accepted gifts. Trust Teddy coordinates the gift invitation and address collection.

Can I process Trust Teddy gifts immediately after installation?

Your store must register and receive Trust Teddy merchant approval first.
sections.changelog:
0.1.7

  • Shipping & Gift Details: First Name and Last Name are now separate fields for both the recipient and the sender, and every field is stacked one per row.
  • Shipping & Gift Details: the sender’s name, phone number and email are prefilled from checkout and editable, and all Sender Information fields except the message are now required.
  • The recipient’s first and last name are saved to the order’s shipping first/last name fields exactly as entered (a multi-word first name is no longer split).
  • Updated the plugin listing description, FAQ and external-service disclosures.

0.1.6

  • The “I don’t have the recipient’s shipping address” checkout option is now hidden automatically if this store isn’t currently enabled by Trust Teddy Core (disabled, or still pending approval) — previously a buyer could still check it and pay, only for the order to silently fail to reach Core afterward.
  • The settings page now shows this store’s live status (Enabled/Disabled/Pending) straight from Trust Teddy Core.
  • Added a way to update this store’s API key from the settings page after Trust Teddy Core rotates it, without needing direct database access.
  • Use a standard copy icon instead of a clipboard glyph on the Copy Link button.

0.1.5

  • Fix gift orders not completing (order never finalized, cart never cleared) when paid via an asynchronous/redirect payment method, e.g. Stripe’s bank/Link option.
  • Fix “Trust Teddy” overlapping the “Why Trust Teddy?” link on narrow screens.
  • Fix the buyer’s “Your gift is ready!” share message sometimes showing the claim link twice (or dropping the message entirely) depending on the share target; the shared text now matches the same “Trust Teddy Gift Notification:” format used elsewhere, including the sender’s name/phone.
  • Copy Link now appears before Share with its own icon, plus a note pointing Windows users to Copy Link and iPhone/Android/Mac users to Share.
  • Fix the share screen not scrolling to the top on load.
  • Make the Sender Information “Full Name” field on the Shipping & Gift Details form editable again (Phone/Email stay locked).

0.1.4

  • The first gift-invite text is no longer sent automatically by Trust Teddy when a recipient phone number is given — the buyer now gets a “Your gift is ready!” screen with the claim link, a Share button (opens their phone’s native share sheet with a prewritten message), and Copy Link, and sends it themselves. Giving a recipient email instead of (or alongside) a phone is unaffected — that invite still sends automatically as before.
  • Copy Link on that screen copies the full prewritten invite message, not just the bare link.

0.1.3

  • Show a loading indicator and disable the Continue button on the “Shipping & Gift Details” form while it submits, so a second tap can’t send the same request twice.

0.1.2

  • The recipient’s accept/decline and shipping-address experience now runs entirely on Trust Teddy’s own site instead of this store — a recipient’s gift link never touches this store’s own domain any more.
  • Redesigned the recipient experience: updated privacy-screen copy and icon labels, full-width address fields, a new “Confirm your shipping address” review step before the gift is finalized, and a success checkmark on every item in a multi-product gift.
  • Added Privacy/Terms links to the privacy and thank-you screens.
  • Fix declining being wrongly blocked after tapping Accept but before finishing the address form.
  • Fix the claim card losing its centering on phone screens (was flush against the left edge with its right edge cut off).

0.1.1

  • Fix the claim/address page’s mobile layout — the accept/decline card and every other claim screen touched the screen edges on phones, and the address form’s name/address and city/state/ZIP rows were unusably narrow.
  • Fix a malformed heart icon rendering as a lopsided shape instead of a heart.

0.1.0

  • Initial release.
